summary.intent: Address findings from a CodeRabbit CLI review of a rotation-hardening branch across SDK, API, and web services, then verify and commit the fixes.
summary.outcome: Applied fixes for buffer-overflow guards, wrapper-key zeroing, a monotonic rotation-generation guard on updateGrant, and structured error logging in owner-reconcile.service.ts; added a regression spec for updateGrant; updated STATE.md/ROADMAP.md and filed a deferred-followups todo; ran the SDK, API, and root typecheck/test matrix and committed the SDK and API fixes.

repo: apps/api/src/shares/shares.service.spec.ts had no existing service-level tests for updateGrant prior to this session; a spec block had to be added from scratch after inspecting the existing test harness.
Rotation state uses a monotonic 'floor bump' guard pattern (enforceResolved) to prevent regressions in rootGeneration; updateGrant needed the same guard added in shares.service.ts.
Key/wrapper buffers returned from RotateReadResult and copied in client.ts need explicit zeroing after use — an overflow guard and zeroing fix were applied at the reconcile gate in client.ts.
The root-level typecheck command differs from per-package typecheck and is what CI actually runs; had to be checked explicitly before trusting local package-level type checks as CI-equivalent.
workflow: Split CodeRabbit findings by layer and delegated batches to parallel subagents (UX-layer, test-file) while handling SDK/API-layer findings directly in the main thread — reduced context usage while fixes proceeded concurrently.
After applying review fixes, ran the affected test matrix (SDK unit suite, API shares specs, web typecheck/lint, API typecheck, root typecheck matching CI) before committing.
Deferred follow-up work discovered during the review was written to .planning/todos/pending/ rather than expanding scope of the current fix session.

friction: Had to run several exploratory Bash searches (rootGeneration column type, UpdateGrantDto validators, existing updateGrant tests) since none of this context was already known going into the fixes.
Needed a separate check to confirm the CI typecheck command matched the root-level command being run locally, since per-package and root typecheck are not equivalent.
open_items: Filed .planning/todos/pending/2026-07-02-rotation-hardening-followups-from-pr-review.md for rotation-hardening followups surfaced during the PR review but not addressed in this session.

Final 'Files Modified' listing only surfaced packages/sdk/src/client.ts even though share.service.ts, rotation-state.service.ts, ipns.service.ts, shares.service.ts, shares.service.spec.ts, owner-reconcile.service.ts, STATE.md, and ROADMAP.md were also edited — worth confirming all intended changes were actually staged/committed.
